description: 🧠 The memory that dreams — cross-session memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: your AI remembers across sessions, consolidates memories in its sleep (autoDream), and manages everything in an interactive memory library panel. Fully offline & private — SQLite + human-editable Markdown mirrors.
summary: 🧠 The memory that dreams — self-evolving memory for DeepSeek Harness: your AI remembers across sessions, consolidates in its sleep, forgets what matters less, and grows smarter over time. Fully offline & private.
